title: Quietly Indulgent Greek Soya Baklava
description: A dairy-free friendly Greek dessert featuring soya milk, with a grassy and fluffy texture, indulgent and sweet, in the form of a baklava.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Layer the phyllo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with olive oil.
Mix the chopped walnuts, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt in a bowl.
Spread the walnut mixture over the phyllo dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Cut the baklava into diamond shaped pieces.
Bake the baklava for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the baklava is baking, mix the soya milk and honey in a saucepan.
Heat the soya milk mixture over medium heat, stirring constantly, until warm and well combined.
Remove the baklava from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Drizzle the warm soya milk mixture over the baklava and serve.
